Veil of Darkness
8% of base mana
Instant1 min cooldown
Envelop a target in a shadowy voodoo veil, increasing the damage you deal to them by 15% for 15 sec.

If you are within 40 yds of the target you deal 194+1.7 Points Per Level+ShaP*0.1+AP*0.045 Shadow damage to them every 1.5 second.
